### Shape

#### Description

Beneath the [RibbonScope](../../ui/components/ribbon/index.md#ribbon-scope), to the right of the [ProjectSidebarScope](../../ui/components/project-sidebar/index.md#project-sidebar-scope), which runs the full height beside it, and reaching the window's right edge. It is part of the [PromptEditor](../prompt-mode/index.md#prompt-editor).
The [ChatInputScope](../prompt-mode/chat-input/index.md#chat-input-scope) lives within the body, along its bottom: its left edge against the project sidebar, and above it, beneath the body's tab bar, the selected tab's contents: the message list, or an open file. While a task runs, the [RightSidebarScope](../../ui/components/right-sidebar/index.md#right-sidebar-scope) runs the body's full height at its right, beside the tab bar, the selected tab's contents, and the chat input, and the chat input's right edge is against it: the chat input never runs beneath the right sidebar. While that sidebar isn't there, the chat input reaches the window's right edge.
The body is flat and quiet: the selected tab's contents, the message list or an open file, sit on the theme's base surface, #444444 in dark mode, running edge to edge with no border, and the chat input along the bottom is set apart from them only by its own darker tab strip, as the [ChatInputScope](../prompt-mode/chat-input/index.md#chat-input-scope) says, with no line between them.

#### Sliding

Whenever something slides out or back along one of the body's edges, as the [RightSidebarScope](../../ui/components/right-sidebar/index.md#right-sidebar-scope) does, everything else in the body moves smoothly with it, frame by frame, rather than jumping once the slide is over: the tab bar, the selected tab's contents, the Ask conversation while it shows, and the chat input all keep their right edge against the sliding edge throughout, so they narrow or widen together, in step with it and with each other. None of them lags behind another, is left at its old width until the slide settles, or runs beneath what is sliding. Their contents are laid out anew at each width as it changes, text wrapping and rows reflowing as they go: the tab bar's tabs, the chat input's text and buttons, the message list's table, and an open file's editor. A slide that reverses partway moves them back from whereve

#### Contents

Everything that can be in the body:

- a tab bar along its top, holding a Chat tab and a tab for each file open
- the [MessageList](../prompt-mode/message-list/index.md#message-list), the chat history, shown beneath the tab bar while the Chat tab is selected
- the hint shown in the message list's place before any task has been sent, or while no project is open, as the [PromptEditor](../prompt-mode/index.md#prompt-editor) and the [NoProjectStateScope](../no-project/index.md#no-project-state-scope) say
- an [EditorScope](../editor/index.md#editor-scope) for each open file, shown beneath the tab bar while its tab is selected
- the [AskConversationScope](../prompt-mode/ask-conversation/index.md#ask-conversation-scope), beside the tab bar and the selected tab's contents, while the chat input's Ask tab is selected
- the [ChatInputScope](../prompt-mode/chat-input/index.md#chat-input-scope), along the bottom beneath whichever tab is selected, and beneath the Ask conversation too
- the [RightSidebarScope](../../ui/components/right-sidebar/index.md#right-sidebar-scope), at the right of all of these, the tab bar and the chat input included, while a task runs

An [InsetPanelScope](../../ui/components/inset-panel/index.md#inset-panel-scope) floats over the whole window, the body included, but is never part of it.

#### Ask Split

While the chat input's Ask tab is selected, the body splits in two, side by side, above the chat input, as the [AskConversationScope](../prompt-mode/ask-conversation/index.md#ask-conversation-scope)

content.content:
#### Tabs

Along the top of the body runs a tab bar, in gpui-kit's default tab styling, across the width the message list takes: from the project sidebar to the right sidebar while a task runs, and to the window's right edge otherwise, or, while the body is split for Ask, to the edge between it and the Ask conversation. Its first tab, Chat, shows the message list, and is always there: it can't be closed or moved. After it comes a tab for each open file, in the order they were opened unless they have been dragged since, scrolling sideways once there are more than fit.
Just one tab's contents show at a time, filling the space between the tab bar and the chat input. The chat input stays along the bottom whichever tab is selected, so a prompt can be written while a file shows. The body starts with Chat selected, and clicking a tab selects it.
Every tab in the bar, Chat and each file's alike, is laid out the same plain way, with nothing extra around it: the bar's full height, 32 pixels, its contents centred up and down in it, 12 pixels of padding at its left, and 12 at its right, and no margin of its own above, below, or beside it, so one tab ends where the next begins, with only the tab styling's own line between them. Nothing is inset from the bar's top or bottom, and the first tab starts at the bar's left edge.
A file's tab shows the file's name, then, while it has unsaved changes, a dot, and then a small close button, an icon button 16 pixels square, set close beside the name, 4 pixels from it or from the dot, with no more room between them however long or short the name is. Since the button has room of its own around its icon, a file tab's right padding is 6 pixels rather than 12, so the icon sits as far from the tab's right edge as the name does from its left; the tab is only as wide as its padding, name, dot, and close button need. Chat's spinner, while something runs, sits 6 pixels after its label, inside the same padding. Hovering a file's tab shows the file's path in the project as its tooltip.
A file's tab can be dragged along the tab bar to reorder the files, as the [DragReorderBehaviour](../../ui/behaviours/drag-reorder/index.md#drag-reorder-behaviour) says, a vertical line showing the gap between two tabs it will land in, and the tab dragged following the pointer as the file's name. Chat stays first: no gap before a file's first tab, between Chat and it, shows the indicator, and Chat itself can't be dragged. Dragging a tab selects it, as clicking it does, and the selection follows the tab to its new place; nothing else about its editor changes. A press on a tab's close button closes it rather than starting a drag. A file opened afterwards still gets its new tab just after the one selected.

#### Open File

A file opened, from the [FileTreeScope](../../ui/components/file-tree/index.md#file-tree-scope) or anywhere else the [OpenFileScope](../open-file/index.md#open-file-scope) says, shows in an [EditorScope](../editor/index.md#editor-scope) in a tab of its own, as many files open at once as are opened. A file not open yet gets a new tab, just after the one selected, and is selected. Opening a file that already has a tab selects that tab instead, leaving its editor as it was, unsaved changes and all.
Nothing slides: a file's tab is selected, and its editor shows, at once, and closing it takes it away at once too. Files never split the body among themselves; the file takes the tab bar's full width above the chat input, beside the Ask conversation while the body is split for Ask.

content.text:
The Chat tab now shows only running tasks, and any other task you open from the Tasks tab opens in its own body tab, like a file. `piton check` reports no problems and `piton build` wrote 82 files.

- **Chat tab:** shows only the tasks running now. When nothing is running, it keeps the last finished task until the next one is sent. That keep-until-next choice is mine, and I can make Chat empty instead.
- **Task tabs:** opening a task from the Tasks tab, or anywhere else, opens a tab just after the selected one, and opening it again selects that tab.
  - **Look:** a mode-coloured bar on the left, a status icon or spinner, the prompt's first line cut at 24 characters, and a close button.
  - **Contents:** the task's header, output table and changed files.
  - **Running tasks:** a running task in a tab keeps updating, with its output locked to the bottom while you're scrolled there.
  - **Behaviour:** task tabs drag and close like file tabs. Closing one doesn't affect the task. They aren't reopened when the project is reopened.
- **Running tasks from the Tasks tab:** opening a running task selects it in Chat's header instead of opening a new tab.
- **Removed:** the "Back to the latest task" bar is gone from the message list and from the previous tasks.

**Anchors the code should follow:** `BodyScope` `#task-tabs`, `#tabs` and `#contents`; `TasksTabScope` `#details`; `PromptEditor` `#previous-tasks`; and `MessageList` `#scrolling-past`.
